title: CausalVerify: An Execution-Grounded Benchmark for LLM Causal Inference Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2609.07944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing causal-inference benchmarks for LLMs mostly score method descriptions or whether generated code runs, not whether the executed workflow recovers the target causal estimate. CausalVerify studies this verification problem for structured econometric causal-estimation workflows by separating realistic interpretation from verifiable computation. It pairs 259 published economics papers (reconstructed research question, data description, institutional context) with 100 fixed-seed synthetic scenarios that realise CSV datasets for difference-in-differences, event study, instrumental variables, and regression discontinuity designs. Experiment A (real-paper text agreement) scores method-family and direction agreement against four-LLM consensus labels. translated_title: CausalVerify：一个面向LLM因果推断工作流的基于执行验证的基准测试
translated_abstract: 现有的LLM因果推断基准主要评估方法描述的质量或生成的代码能否运行，而非执行的工作流是否能够恢复目标因果估计。CausalVerify针对结构化计量经济学因果估计工作流研究了这一验证问题，通过将现实世界的解释与可验证的计算相分离。该基准将259篇已发表的经济学论文（包含重构的研究问题、数据描述和制度背景）与100个固定种子的合成场景配对，这些场景实现了双重差分法、事件研究、工具变量法和断点回归设计的CSV数据集。实验A（真实论文文本一致性）根据四个LLM的共识标签对方法族和效应方向的一致性进行评分。实验B（合成执行）运行模型编写的R代码，并检查提取的处理效应估计是否与同一数据集上标准估计器的结果相匹配；该执行...
tldr: CausalVerify提出了一个基于执行验证的因果推断基准，将真实经济学论文与合成数据场景配对，用以检验LLM工作流是否真正恢复了目标因果估计，而非仅评估代码能否运行。
en_tdlr: CausalVerify introduces an execution-grounded benchmark that pairs real economics papers with fixed-seed synthetic scenarios to verify whether LLM causal-inference workflows actually recover the target causal estimates, rather than merely checking whether generated code runs.
